business_problem: Target wanted to make shopping more personalized and seamless for guests while also giving store teams better on-the-job support, but it needed an enterprise approach that could move generative AI from experimentation into concrete retail applications.
solution_summary: Target worked with Bain's product, data science, engineering, and strategy teams to stand up a repeatable generative AI capability and launch several applications. Store Companion is a proprietary chatbot that answers process questions, coaches new team members, and supports store operations management. Product Display Pages use generative AI to improve hundreds of thousands of Target.com listings with review summaries and better titles and descriptions so guests can find items faster. Bullseye Gift Finder serves personalized recommendations across web, mobile, and app experiences based on attributes such as age, hobbies, and favorite brands. Together, the tools show an operating model in which internal retail questions, product content, and guest shopping prompts flow into different serving layers on shared enterprise infrastructure. The source does not name a storage platform, but it explicitly says Bain helped Target create the internal infrastructure needed to experiment and scale.
